title: Bira – Bira’ah – Birai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Sukkah 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.27a.10), Hyman quotes Rabbi Bira speaking in the name of Rabbi Ami. At [34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.34b.5), the speaker in Rabbi Ami’s name is called Bira’ah. In Bereshit Rabbah 47:5: Rabbi Abba bar Kahana in the name of Rabbi Birai; likewise he is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Sotah, chapter 3. There is also Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Birai: Midrash Shmuel 13:6. In Terumot 10:6: “Rabbi Zeira, Ada bar Gershon, Rabbi Birai”; in Pesachim, end of chapter 2: “One of those of Rabbi Birai had,” etc.

notes.text: The supplied Rabbi Bira is retained. Saved Davidson Sukkah 27a writes Bira without that title. The several spellings and father/son reference remain distinct rather than globally harmonized.
